name: Reduce mixed-step GDN/FLA host dispatch and temporary-buffer work if lightweight measurements confirm it
current_behavior: A100 mixed_forward_core is an eager custom-op boundary, invoked30 times per mixed step. It performs convolution/prep, packed decode, state gather/zero, an autograd.Function FLA call chain with repeated Python/Triton launches and input_guard contiguous/device checks, final-state scatter and output copy. ChunkGatedDeltaRule.forward_native already accepts core_attn_out, and chunk_fwd_o supports a supplied flattened output buffer, but Omni gdn.py232-244 does not pass that buffer and246 copies the returned output.
support: Selected C8 attempt2 CPU audit:22 mixed steps; vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core660 calls with878322.525us inclusive total(39.923751ms/step), nested ChunkGatedDeltaRuleFunction384717.672us not additive. CPU scope p50=58.954110ms, CUDA runtime interval-union p50=8.097228ms;54 GraphLaunch calls sum to mean2.826880ms/step. No Synchronize API or correlated D2H was observed in these audited scopes. Independent C16/C64 reproduce mixed CPU scope medians58.110/60.268ms and same-name GDN core interval-union medians38.297/39.611ms; runtime unions7.847/7.981ms and graph-launch sums means2.730/2.778ms. experiment: First run a short separate matched workload with torch.profiler disabled and minimal perf_counter_ns probes around aggregate mixed_forward_core and its gather/prep/chunk/scatter sections. Buffer counters in memory, emit only after the window; no per-layer print or synchronize. Repeat with probes disabled to bound instrumentation cost. Compare CPU enqueue durations with separately sampled GPU events and end-to-end TTFA/stall/RTF, controlling CPU affinity/thermal state. If material host cost persists, first prototype passing contiguous flattened core_attn_out[decode_tokens:tokens] through the existing FLA output-buffer API and remove only the redundant output allocation/copy; measure this isolated change. Then investigate scratch-buffer reuse or fused gather/zero/scatter only if evidence supports them. Do not promise the full39.9ms is removable.
quality_validation: Use the real FLA/Triton path, not the original test fixture that dispatches FlashInfer. Cover fp32 and bf16 recurrent state, decode counts0/3 plus actual8/16/64, fresh/continuing/chunked prefills, differing reference lengths and slot reuse. Check every output/state against standard path with existing tolerances and no dtype change; test output aliasing/contiguity and graph replay. Then official E2E and fixed-seed1088 noise-run/capped-length/WER/SIM companion against control.
capture_constraints: GDN backend declares UNIFORM_BATCH. Variable prefill cu_seqlens/chunk-count/state indexing and scratch lifetimes prevent treating forced FULL mixed capture or deleting splitting_ops as a safe configuration change. Any per-shape graph proposal needs bounded static buffers and updated metadata on replay, with capture/memory/startup costs measured.
scope_note: Hypothesis based on profiled inclusive CPU scopes, which include instrumentation overhead. No unprofiled timing or implementation exists yet. span-busy is not all CPU idle; nested CPU durations must never be added. Output-buffer reuse is a concrete Omni-side candidate with likely limited payoff, not proof it fixes the whole mixed-step delay. All three selected profiles corroborate the profiled mixed host pattern. Priority is to establish its unprofiled size; no end-to-end CPU bottleneck or removable-time amount is proven.
